commit.message:
LU-16918 build: Restore --disable-modules support

fix a defined but not used `kfi_intflist2cxi()` by wrapping
it in #ifdef HAVE_KFILND

enable building `--enable-gss --enable-gss-keyring` by skipping
the kernel checks when `--disable-modules` is used.
